# Effects

A plugin lists its effects as `[[then]]` tables with an `effect` key.

| Effect   | Fields                                                                               | Behaviour                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `inject` | `text`, `fallback`                                                                   | Adds the text to the agent's context. Dropped when the host cannot add context on this event or the context budget is used up. `fallback` lists effects to try instead where the host cannot add context.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `block`  | `reason`, `suppress_original_prompt` (prompt.submit only, default false), `fallback` | Stops the prompt or tool call and shows the reason. The first block in output order wins. With `block_requires_rule` on (the default), a check that is not model-backed must be true. Where the host cannot block, a `fallback` list picks what to do instead (`inject`, `notify`, or `[]` to drop); without one it becomes a notice, or is dropped where the host cannot notify either. A block dropped for lacking a rule never falls back. |
| `notify` | `text`, `fallback`                                                                   | Shows the text to the user, not the agent. Dropped when the host cannot notify on this event, unless `fallback` names an effect to use instead.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |

## Support per host and event

| Host           | `prompt.submit`       | `session.start` | `tool.before`         | `tool.after`          |
| -------------- | --------------------- | --------------- | --------------------- | --------------------- |
| Claude Code    | inject, block, notify | inject, notify  | inject, block, notify | inject, block, notify |
| CodeBuddy Code | inject, block, notify | inject, notify  | inject, block, notify | inject, notify        |
| Codex          | inject, block, notify | inject, notify  | inject, block, notify | inject, block, notify |
| Factory Droid  | inject, block, notify | inject, notify  | block, notify         | inject, block, notify |
| Gemini CLI     | inject, block, notify | inject, notify  | block, notify         | inject, block, notify |
| opencode       | inject, notify        | inject, notify  | block, notify         | inject, notify        |
| Qoder CLI      | inject, block, notify | inject, notify  | inject, block, notify | inject, notify        |
| Qwen Code      | inject, block, notify | inject, notify  | inject, block, notify | inject, block, notify |
